observations.explanation: The paper describes filtering roughly 90,000 PRs through issue/test-related attribute checks and execution validation, yielding 2,294 task instances (PDF pp. 2, 15, 19).
The paper reports Claude 2's 4.8% resolution rate with oracle retrieval and identifies it as the best-performing model (PDF p. 5; results table on p. 6).
The paper explicitly states that all SWE-bench task instances are in Python and presents expansion to other languages and domains as future work (PDF p. 9).
The paper explicitly cautions that execution-based testing alone cannot guarantee reliable model generations, also noting limitations in comprehensiveness, efficiency, or readability (PDF p. 9).
